# Anthropic University

> Unofficial, community-authored study hub for Anthropic's Claude certifications: Claude Certified Associate: Foundations, Developer: Foundations, Architect: Foundations, and Architect: Professional. Each track has 100 original practice questions with explanations, a study guide and a flashcard set, plus a static web app and a Claude Code plugin marketplace. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, and it does not reproduce real exam questions.

The canonical data is `content/<track>/questions.json` and `flashcards.json`. Every markdown exam, flashcard file, web app data file and plugin data file is generated from them by `node scripts/build.mjs`.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/README.md): what the project is, how to study, how to install the plugins
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, schema and rules for working in the repo
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): authoring quality bar and PR checklist

## Study guides

- [Associate: Foundations study guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/associate-foundations/study-guide.md): everyday use of Claude, prompting, evaluating output, workflows, configuration, governance
- [Developer: Foundations study guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/developer-foundations/study-guide.md): model choice, the Claude API, tool use, agents, Claude Code and MCP, evals and security
- [Architect: Foundations study guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/architect-foundations/study-guide.md): multi-agent orchestration, Claude Code in CI, support agents, code generation, API, SDK and MCP
- [Architect: Professional study guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/architect-professional/study-guide.md): solution design, enterprise integration, safety, evals as acceptance criteria, stakeholder lifecycle

## Practice exams

- [Associate: Foundations practice exam](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/associate-foundations/practice-exam.md): 100 original questions with answers and explanations
- [Developer: Foundations practice exam](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/developer-foundations/practice-exam.md): 100 original questions with answers and explanations
- [Architect: Foundations practice exam](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/architect-foundations/practice-exam.md): 100 original questions with answers and explanations
- [Architect: Professional practice exam](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/content/architect-professional/practice-exam.md): 100 original questions with answers and explanations

## Tools

- [Web app source](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/tree/main/docs): static Study, Practice, timed Exam and Flashcards modes in vanilla JS
- [Plugin marketplace](https://github.com/patrickking67/anthropic-university/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code plugins exam-coach, flashcard-drill and cert-author
